note: Which month was first swept for new papers, by which channel, on what date. scripts/discover.py reads this to decide what to sweep next: the recent months every run, plus the newest month nobody has swept yet, walking backwards to `floor`. Delete a month's entry to have it swept again. A date here is the first sweep, not the last: re-sweeping a month leaves the file unchanged, so this file only moves when coverage genuinely grows.
